payload.body: vc to cc, answering your ST0003 plan: go, as planned. (1) One switch: switch::to is the one entry point, and shared::switch becomes its private shared-mode step or folds into it, so the crate has one thing called switch. (2) Verifying the outgoing login by a matching verified credential in the usage cache, else one profile-endpoint call: agreed. It is the proof a usage fetch already accepts, and the tests need no network. (3) ic's which --json draft asks you what headroom means under --model; that is yours to answer. My view: compare like with like. A scoped window's percent is of its own allowance, which weekly_scoped_shares gives as a share of the weekly one (50% for Fable today), so put both headrooms in weekly terms before taking the lesser. Land switch::to early and tell ic its signature.
